validity: A plan binds only to the (config, FIDESlib binary) pair recorded here. If either differs at the destination, recapture and replan -- a stale plan fails as a silent wrong answer, not an error. Captures are deterministic: to prove a carried-forward plan is still valid, recapture and diff the graph against the archived one; node-identical means the plan holds.
